editor.premise: A hands-on day of cable-railing work, kitchen interruptions, and vehicle preparations, told through practical demonstrations and informal conversation.

chapters.name: Morning setup
chapters.purpose: Move from branded introduction into the day's domestic conversation.

chapters.name: Railing installation
chapters.purpose: Explain the cable-fitting process through repeated actions and close views.

chapters.name: Kitchen break
chapters.purpose: Interrupt the technical work with food, conversation, and a laugh.

chapters.name: Finishing railing
chapters.purpose: Compress remaining work, then inspect the result from several angles.

chapters.name: Vehicle plans
chapters.purpose: Introduce the next task and move from the doorway into a vehicle.

captions.note: A repeated lower-third teaser label bridges changing images; a centered logo follows. Later, brief labels and asides appear selectively rather than continuously captioning speech.

editor.notes: Keep distinct assembly steps, but jump past repeated handling. Alternate working-distance views with close mechanical details. Let conversation breathe longer than tool inserts. Food cutaways interrupt repetition; the finished railing earns a slower, multi-angle inspection.
